verdict.rationale: Name.com offers webhook subscriptions for domain and account events such as transfer status changes, renewals and registry compliance notices. These push real-time notifications to your endpoint, but you have to build the action logic yourself. Besides webhooks, the only automatic behavior evidenced is an autorenew setting; there is no built-in rule engine. Missing for 10: native user-defined event→action rules, conditional logic or workflow builder, documentation of the full webhook event catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.
